member.name: T:White_Knuckle_Multiplayer.LogManager
member.summary:
Centralized logging with four contexts:
Type Description
Base plain BepInEx logger
Server prefixes messages with [SERVER]
Client prefixes messages with [CLIENT]
Net prefixes messages with [NET]
Registry prefixes messages with [Registry]
Initialize once in plugin entrypoint: LogManager.Init(Logger);
Then to enable or disable debug logs at runtime: LogManager.DebugEnabled = true;
Then use anywhere like so:
LogManager.Server.Info("Started"); LogManager.Client.Debug("Value={0}", value);
